curves.name: Fig. 1 Power Derating Curve (family-wide, applies to MM1W3V9)
curves.test_conditions: Ratings and characteristics curves stated at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified; curve is drawn flat at 1.0 W from 0 degC to 75 degC ambient, then derates linearly to 0 W at 150 degC. Interior points at 100 degC and 125 degC are read from the drawn straight-line segment (slope -1.0 W / 75 degC).

datasheet_identity.title: MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330 Surface Mount Zener Diodes (SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330; target-specific evidence taken from the MM1W3V9 row (type code FHF) of the Electrical Characteristics table on page 2.

MM1W3V9 row values (page 2, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted): VZ min 3.70 V / nom 3.9 V / max 4.10 V at IZT = 64 mA; maximum zener impedance ZZT = 9.0 ohm at IZT = 64 mA; leakage IR = 50 uA at VR = 1 V; admissible zener current IZM = 243 mA. ZZT and IZM have no dedicated schema field and are recorded here.

Family maximum ratings (page 1, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified): power dissipation PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 degC; VF = 1.2 V at IF = 200 mA; Tstg and Tj -55 to +150 degC; typical thermal resistance RthJA = 375 degC/W.
Polarity: cathode line (band) denotes the cathode end; SOD-123 package (page 1). Zener operates in reverse breakdown: VZ is the reverse voltage across cathode-anode at reverse current IZT.

Note an internal datasheet inconsistency: the Maximum Ratings table states PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 degC (case temperature), while Fig. 1 derates PD versus ambient temperature Ta with the knee at 75 degC. The curve is digitized as drawn (ambient temperature axis).

Fig. 2 'Typical Transient Thermal Impedance' (page 3, family-wide, log-log, 0.01-100 s vs 1-1000 degC/W) was omitted: the plot has no legible intermediate gridline crossings in the rendered PDF to digitize real points with confidence, so extracting it would require inventing values.
No capacitance and no reverse-recovery specifications appear anywhere in the datasheet; those fields are null.

source_kind 'typical' on the two test-condition currents (IF = 200 mA, IZT = 64 mA) and on the nominal VZ marks stated datasheet condition/nominal columns; the schema enum has no 'specified condition' or 'nominal' option.

breakdown_current.conditions: IZT, reverse (zener) test current at which VZ and ZZT are specified for MM1W3V9, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. Stated test-condition current, not a min/typ/max distribution value.

breakdown_voltage.conditions: Nominal reverse zener voltage VZ at IZT = 64 mA, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted; datasheet row MM1W3V9 specifies VZ min = 3.70 V, nom = 3.9 V, max = 4.10 V at the same IZT. Nominal value recorded here; source_kind 'typical' denotes the nominal column.

current.conditions: Forward bias test condition for the VF maximum rating; Maximum Ratings table, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified. Stated test-condition current, not a min/typ/max distribution value.

voltage.conditions: Forward voltage at IF = 200 mA; Maximum Ratings table, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified

reverse_current.conditions: Reverse leakage current IR at reverse voltage VR = 1 V, Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted (Electrical Characteristics row MM1W3V9). Table column 'Leakage Current IR@VR' is not explicitly labeled min/typ/max; treated as the specified upper limit per datasheet convention.
